DDL	create table t as
SESSION	declare avro_schema string
SESSION	set variable avro_schema =
READ	select from_avro(s, 42, map()) from t
READ	select from_avro(s, avro_schema, 42) from t
READ	select to_avro(s, 42) from t
READ	select to_avro(s, avro_schema) as result from t
READ	select from_avro(result, avro_schema, map()).u from (select null as result)
SESSION	drop temporary variable avro_schema
DDL	drop table t
